outcome.technical: Vendored elkjs 0.12.0 (npm pack elkjs@0.12.0; lib/elk.bundled.js copied unmodified to assets/viewer/elk.bundled.js, sha256 1222e44f953ce7746af23801e723708f8e6f436b8b377a6a5fc7552f34a307b3, 1609707 bytes; 0.12.1 published today was NOT used). assets/viewer/ELK-NOTICE.md records package, version, source URL, sha256, EPL-2.0 election (dual EPL-2.0 OR GPL-3.0-or-later), the EPL notice text/link and the Kiel University copyright lines found in the file. No package.json added. scripts/layout.mjs (Node>=18 ESM, loads the vendored bundle via createRequire): exports layoutModel(model,{layout}) and LAYOUT_SCHEMA_VERSION; CLI `node scripts/layout.mjs <model.json> [--layout f] [--out f]` validates with the exported validate() first (invalid -> exit 1, nothing written), exit 2 for usage/unreadable/bad-schemaVersion seed/layout failure; --out defaults to --layout else architecture.layout.json beside the model; a missing --layout file is treated as no seed with a stderr note. Fresh layout: ELK layered, RIGHT, ORTHOGONAL, randomSeed 1, inputs sorted by id, zones as compound nodes (zone.parent nesting, padding top 36), deterministic text-metric node sizes. Output {schemaVersion:1, graph:{nodes,zones,edges:{id:{sections}}}, er:{entities (with extra ports:{field:{x,y,side}}), relations keyed 'from.entity.field->to.entity.field'}} in absolute graph coords. Seeded layout: unchanged-size seeded nodes keep their position, pinned (pinned:true) nodes keep exact x,y and the flag, new/resized nodes are parked by a deterministic grid ring search next to their zone (no overlap with nodes or foreign zones), zone boxes are recomputed but a seed box that still holds its members is kept, seed edge routes are kept if endpoints still sit on the node borders else re-routed by a simple orthogonal router; re-running on its own output is byte-identical. ER: one ELK port per field row (FIXED_POS, WEST for target-only fields else EAST), relation edges attach to field ports. Tests: tests/layout.test.mjs l1-l8. Verified: `node --test tests/layout.test.mjs` 8/8 pass; `node --test` 58/58 pass, exit 0; CLI run on the golden model: 51/51 edge endpoints on node borders, in-place seeded re-run byte-identical (cmp). Red first: the tests were written before scripts/layout.mjs existed and all 8 failed with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND (module import error, not an assertion) before implementation. ELK-NOTICE.md and tests/layout.test.mjs: no tracked dependants.
